service.description: Finds an order id (a Shopify id or name, a HotWax order or external id, a NetSuite number or id, or any id a tenant read takes) in every connected system and follows the order through Shopify, HotWax and NetSuite, with its open findings. Every read is a read-only fresh query on the tenant's own connection. Order facts by default; customer name, email, phone and address only with all.

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The id as the person gave it.

parameter.name: all
parameter.description: Every field each read selects, customer details included.

parameter.name: lookup
parameter.description: {value, records: [{system, connectionId, connectionLabel, recordKind, readId, foundBy, record}], findings, skipped, readsUsed, capped}
